name: valley-last-16px-ruins
label: pixellab-valley-last-16px-ruins
provenance: PixelLab Pro grids on the paid account (trial1), our own 16 px ruin sprites x4 as the shape references and the kit's rich standing_stone and broken_statue as level and camera references. Lane valley-last-16px, public #917; DECISIONS 2026-11-02 PixelLab draws the world's pieces.

inputs.description: a tall broken ancient stone pillar standing upright, pale grey weathered stone with cracks and a chipped broken top, a square base block, green moss and a few ivy leaves climbing the lower half, tall and narrow. Seen from high above at fifty degrees, the game's three-quarter top-down view, soft light from the upper left, short soft shadow side, painterly pixel art with many shades, moss and ivy on the shaded and lower parts, no thick black outline, weathered ancient ruin in a river valley, the whole object alone on a transparent background.

reference_images.usage_description: The object to redraw: the same tall broken pillar, same pose, same proportions and silhouette, but drawn far richer with fine pixels. Do not copy its coarse pixels.

Only the level of finish, the camera and the light: the game's three-quarter top-down view from high above at fifty degrees, soft light from the upper left, painterly stone with moss, no thick black outline. Do not copy this stone.
Only the level of finish, the camera and the light, as the other picture. Do not copy this statue.
